subject: general
question: As per Census of India 2011, which of the following groups of states recorded the lowest literacy rate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar and Arunachal Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bihar and Arunachal Pradesh** recorded the lowest literacy rates as per the Census of India 2011.
 
• The Census of India 2011 is the **15th National census** survey conducted by the Census Organization of India.
 
• **Bihar** had a **literacy rate of 61.80****%**, which was the lowest among all states.
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** had a **literacy rate of 66.95%**, placing it among the lowest literacy rates in the country.
 
• These figures highlight the educational challenges faced by these states and the need for focused educational policies and programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Census of India** is conducted every ten years by the** Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner**, under the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
 
• The census provides comprehensive data on the demographic, social, and economic characteristics of the Indian population.
 
• It is crucial for planning and policy-making processes in various sectors, including education, healthcare, and infrastructure development.
 
• The literacy rate is a key indicator of educational attainment and is defined as the percentage of people aged seven and above who can read and write with understanding.
 
• Efforts to improve literacy rates include government initiatives like the Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan and the National Literacy Mission.
